title: Docking v4: clean-room (dockv4) vs project implementation - pre-declared comparison
disclosure: Before this file was written, one timing probe generated 50 project panels per cell for (social a=0.30, r=0.70) and (B phi=0.80 lambda=0.30, r=0.70) and printed their L1-L5 means; mine were printed for 50 panels with a different seed layout. No test, margin or grid below was changed after that probe; margins are generic (standardized) and fixed here.

namespaces.note: The project code is driven through a SeedPlan subclass whose seed() uses the docking namespace; no calibration, gate or confirmatory namespace is used.

geometry.N_reason: 1000 is not divisible by 6 (2-person households, 2/3 entering at t=0); nearest valid size.

part_A_seed_level.purpose: Deterministic docking with identical 64-bit seeds where the draw order is specified the same way (latent state, network, null-state).

checks.lag_feature_function: dockv4 pooled_lag_corr on the project's observed panel equals project lag_profile L1..L5 within 1e-12 (20 panels per family, r=0.7)
checks.lda_auc_function: On identical feature matrices (50 replications from part C inputs), |AUC_dock - AUC_project| <= 1e-3; exact differences reported. Tolerance reflects Q12 (standardisation ddof not specified).

part_B_panel_level.project_path: PanelSource._profiles via PanelSource.profiles(phase='check') for L1..L5 (production path, class indices 2j and 2j+1, network floor(index/4)); a mirror calling the same public functions in the same order (influence/null, panel_mask, measurement, ordinal_channel) supplies full panels for per-wave and cross-wave summaries, and must reproduce PanelSource L1..L5 bitwise on the same seeds.
part_B_panel_level.docking_path: dockv4.model.panel with Streams(namespace, block=0, phase='check', index=2j+class, network=index//4).

summaries_per_panel.var_t: variance of observed category per wave (11)
summaries_per_panel.L1..L10: pooled within-panel lag-k Pearson (the spec's Lk; L1 and L5 are the requested lag-1/lag-5 autocorrelations of individual trajectories)
summaries_per_panel.wave_corr: 55 upper-triangular entries of the pairwise-complete 11x11 cross-wave correlation matrix

primary_equivalence.endpoints: per cell: means of L1, L2, L3, L4, L5 and of total respondents sum_t n_obs_t (6 x 25 = 150 TOSTs)
primary_equivalence.test: TOST (two one-sided Welch t tests), alpha=0.05 each; overall claim by intersection-union (no multiplicity adjustment needed for an all-equivalent claim)
primary_equivalence.margin: standardized: |mean_dock - mean_project| <= 0.20 x pooled per-panel SD of the endpoint
primary_equivalence.margin_justification: A location shift of 0.20 SD in one class of a single feature corresponds to a single-feature population AUC of Phi(0.20/sqrt 2) = 0.556 at the panel level, the smallest shift that could plausibly masquerade as a detectable signal against the 0.70 target once combined across L3-L5; with 1000 panels per arm SE(d) = 0.045, so the TOST has power >= 0.99 per endpoint when the true difference is 0, keeping the expected number of spurious non-equivalences over 150 endpoints below 1. Smaller real differences (< 0.2 SD, i.e. about 0.003 in L-units at N=1002) are below this docking's resolution and are covered only by part A (seed level).

tests: Welch two-sample t test on every scalar summary (98 per cell; zero-variance-in-both summaries compared for exact equality instead)
two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov on L1, L3 and L5
secondary_difference_tests.correction: Holm over all secondary tests jointly, family-wise alpha = 0.05
secondary_difference_tests.effect_sizes: standardized mean difference d (pooled SD), variance ratio, KS D; for wave_corr also max |delta| and Frobenius norm of the difference of mean matrices per cell

cells.theta: fitted once by dockv4 profile matcher (M=256, namespace ...-match), then used by both implementations
fitted once by dockv4 profile matcher (M=256)

part_C_discriminator.per_replication: block = replication; train 100 networks x 2 events per class (phase 'train'), test 250 networks x 2 events per class (phase 'check'); each implementation generates its own panels with its own seeds, computes L3-L5, fits its own LDA and computes its own AUC
part_C_discriminator.reduction_note: Production is 1000 train / 2000 test networks per class at N=10626; reduced for compute. Absolute AUC values are therefore not the study's estimand.
part_C_discriminator.tests: Welch t on mean AUC, KS on the AUC distributions, Brown-Forsythe on spread (included in the Holm family above); TOST on mean AUC with margin 0.02
part_C_discriminator.margin_justification: 0.02 AUC is about one planned confirmatory SE (0.0187-0.0255, v1 power table) and below one grid-step change in the curve that matters for a*; a docking difference below it could not move a detection decision by itself at production precision.
part_C_discriminator.also_reported: fraction of replications with AUC >= 0.70 in each implementation

classification_of_discrepancies.c: probable project-code mismatch with the spec (file:line, spec quote, minimal reproducer)
